title: Fiscal and commercial data
description: Organize the options your team chooses when registering a customer. Work with one list at a time and preserve the codes required by your tax authority or electronic invoicing provider.

identificationTypes.guidance: Define the documents accepted to identify a customer, such as a national ID, tax ID, or passport. Use the exact code required on the electronic invoice.

personTypes.guidance: Distinguish whether the customer is registered as an individual or a legal entity. This classification is part of their fiscal profile.

regimeTypes.guidance: Record the tax regime that applies to the customer. Confirm the name and code with your accountant or fiscal provider before adding it.

clientTypes.guidance: Group customers by their commercial relationship, such as retail or wholesale. This classification organizes operations and does not change taxes by itself.

commercialActivities.search: Search activities by name or code...
commercialActivities.guidance: Store the customer's main economic activity when their profile or invoice requires it. Use the current official code that applies.

permissionNote: You can review these lists. Only an administrator can modify them.
